""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_sigs = set() # Try multiple approaches to find functions # 1. Look for dt/dd pairs (Sphinx documentation style) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt") for dt in dt_blocks: text = dt.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and text not in seen_sigs: seen_sigs.add(text) # Extract description from following dd element desc = "No description found" dd = dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: # Get first paragraph or full text first_p = dd.find("p") desc = first_p.get_text(strip=True) if first_p else dd.get_text(strip=True) desc = desc[:300] # Limit description length functions.append({ "name": text.split("(")[0].strip(), "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 2. Look for code blocks with nearby descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and text not in seen_sigs: seen_sigs.add(text) # Try to find description in parent or sibling elements desc = "No description found" parent = block.parent if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name in ["p", "div", "dd"]: desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:300] functions.append({ "name": text.split("(")[0].strip(), "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for function signatures in headers with descriptions for header_tag in ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(header_tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and text not in seen_sigs: seen_sigs.add(text) # Get description from next paragraph desc = "No description found" next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: desc = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:300] functions.append({ "name": text.split("(")[0].strip(), "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 4. Look for pre/code blocks with function definitions for pre in soup.find_all("pre"): for line in pre.get_text().split("\n"): if "def " in line and "(" in line and ")" in line: sig = line.strip() if sig not in seen_sigs: seen_sigs.add(sig) functions.append({ "name": sig.split("(")[0].replace("def", "").strip(), "signature": sig, "description": "Function definition from code block", "parameters": extract_parameters(sig), }) return functions[:40] # Return more functions for better completeness def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Handles type hints, default values, and nested structures. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] # Extract content within parentheses, handling -> return type sig_without_return = signature.split("->")[0] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", sig_without_return) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Handle nested parentheses/brackets in type hints param_parts = [] current = [] depth = 0 for char in param_string + ",": if char in "([{": depth += 1 current.append(char) elif char in ")]}": depth -= 1 current.append(char) elif char == "," and depth == 0: param_parts.append("".join(current).strip()) current = [] else: current.append(char) for part in param_parts: if not part: continue # Extract name, type, and default value param_name = part param_type = "unknown" param_default = None # Check for default value (handle = in default values) if "=" in part: name_part, default_val = part.split("=", 1) param_name = name_part param_default = default_val.strip() # Check for type annotation if ":" in param_name: name_part, type_part = param_name.split(":", 1) param_name = name_part.strip() param_type = type_part.strip() else: param_name = param_name.strip() # Clean up name (remove *, **) param_name = param_name.lstrip("*").strip() if param_name: params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": param_default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
